title: EBay to lay off 9% of workforce in its second round of job cuts this year
summary_full: EBay will lay off 9% of its workforce, or about 1,000 employees, as it works to focus on its "top strategic priorities."
summary_public: EBay will lay off 9% of its workforce, or about 1,000 employees, as it works to focus on its "top strategic priorities."
